conbody.p: In the code below, profiling attributes like audience="admin" and audience="poweruser admin" are used to conditionally control which parts of the task are shown to which users at publish time.

ul.li: audience="admin" on the third <step> means that step only appears in outputs targeted at administrators (for example, an admin‑only guide or PDF), while regular users never see it.
audience="poweruser admin" on the JSON‑format <li> means that bullet only appears in outputs where the audience is either poweruser or admin, so a basic‑user version of the guide will omit that item.

conbody.p: These attributes let you maintain a single source topic but generate different variants of the same task (e.g., “user guide” and “admin guide”) without duplicating the whole file.
